codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: Does this site cover Enshrouded 1.0?
items.answer: Yes — this site was built for 1.0 (released October 15, 2026). Cinder’s Cradle, Sparkworks and the post-1.0 build changes are its core pages.

items.question: Why another Enshrouded wiki?
items.answer: The official community wiki has deep EA-era coverage but its 1.0 hub pages were still missing days after launch. This site focuses on exactly that gap: deep, dated 1.0 content.

items.question: What changed in 1.0?
items.answer: 1.0 ended Early Access on October 15, 2026: the Cinder’s Cradle region, the Sparkworks system, nine new spells and eternal upgrades came with it. See our build and zone guides.

items.question: Is this site affiliated with Keen Games?
items.answer: No. It is an unofficial player-made guide, re-verified and dated after every game update.

items.question: What level is Cinder’s Cradle for?
items.answer: The final region is tuned for characters approaching the new level cap of 50; the Ancient Gate also checks your Flame level. The prep checklist is in the zone guide.

items.question: Is Sparkworks optional?
items.answer: No. It sits in the 1.0 main loop, not beside it — treating it as a side system means grinding the old way at the new cap.

items.question: How many spells did 1.0 add?
items.answer: Nine new spells, plus eternal upgrades. Staff and summoner lines have the most immediate uses for them.

items.question: Do Early Access saves carry over?
items.answer: Yes. 1.0 moved saves to a new format; back up before migrating. What changes is your endgame plan, not your progress.
